message.content:
Here’s a classic lasagna recipe with all the essential ingredients you’ll need:

| Category | Ingredient | Typical Amount (for a 9×13‑inch pan) |
|----------|------------|--------------------------------------|
| **Lasagna noodles** | Regular or no‑boil lasagna sheets | 12–15 sheets |
| **Meat sauce** | Ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork) | 1½–2 lb (680–900 g) |
| | Onion, finely chopped | 1 medium |
| | Garlic cloves, minced | 2–3 cloves |
| | Crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce | 28 oz (800 g) |
| | Tomato paste | 2 Tbsp |
| | Olive oil | 2 Tbsp |
| | Salt, pepper, dried oregano, basil, red‑pepper flakes | to taste |
| | Optional: red wine, bay leaf, carrot & celery (finely diced) | as desired |
| **Ricotta mixture** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz (425 g) |
| | Egg (helps bind) | 1 large |
| | Grated Parmesan | ½ cup (50 g) |
| | Fresh parsley, chopped | 2 Tbsp |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |
| **Bechamel sauce** | Butter | 4 Tbsp |
| | All‑purpose flour | 4 Tbsp |
| | Milk (whole or 2%) | 4 cups (950 ml) |
| | Nutmeg, grated | pinch |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |
| **Cheese topping** | Shredded mozzarella | 2–3 cups (200–300 g) |
| | Grated Parmesan | ½ cup (50 g) |
| | Optional: shredded provolone or fontina | ½ cup (50 g) |

### Quick Prep Steps
1. **Cook the noodles** (if using regular ones) until al dente; drain and set aside on a lightly oiled sheet to prevent sticking.
2. **Make the meat sauce**: sauté onion & garlic in olive oil, add ground meat until browned, then stir in crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, herbs, and optional wine. Simmer for 20–30 min.
3. **Prepare the ricotta layer**: mix ricotta, egg, Parmesan, parsley, salt, and pepper.
4. **Whisk the béchamel**: melt butter, whisk in flour, gradually add milk while whisking until thickened, season with nutmeg, salt, and pepper.
5. **Assemble**: start with a thin layer of meat sauce at the bottom, then layers of noodles, ricotta mixture, béchamel, and shredded mozzarella. Repeat until all components are used, finishing with a generous mozzarella layer on top.
6. **Bake**: cover with foil (to avoid burning the cheese) and bake at 375 °F (190 °C) for 25 min, then remove foil and bake another 10–15 min until bubbly and golden.

Enjoy your homemade lasagna!
